item.title: Farmers in Crisis Under Trump Administration
item.description: (AURN News) — Farm bankruptcies are rising again. According to U.S. Courts data, Chapter 12 bankruptcy filings — the protection designed specifically for family farmers — jumped 46% in 2025 to 315 cases, marking the second straight year of increases. item.title: On This Day: Kentucky Rejected the 13th Amendment
item.description: (AURN News) — On this day in 1865, the Kentucky General Assembly refused to ratify the 13th Amendment, which abolished slavery except as punishment for a crime.
